description: Soft fingertip on a small brass-inlaid stone control.
A dry parchment edge lifted from the hand; quiet for repeated selection.
Two overlapping parchment slides and a restrained edge flick.
Parchment cast onto a stone table, with a soft felt-backed landing.
A compact leather-and-stone impact with no elemental resonance.
A brief furnace flare, warm impact, and fading ember crackle.
A cool, hollow water strike followed by four diminishing droplets.
A dry root-and-bark snap with a low wooden body and rustling leaves.
A worn bronze edge struck against armor; a short, dark inharmonic ring.
A sandstone thump with small gravel settling behind the impact.
A breath of cool water and two gentle resonant tones, suggesting recovery.
A heavy protective rim seats into place, followed by a muted bronze hum.
Three small treasure chimes, like warm brass tokens settling in a dish.
Two coins counted over parchment with a soft counter tap.
A restrained forge strike blossoms into a rising bronze resonance.
A leather strap tightens and a weathered armor clasp closes.
A small cork releases, followed by a short, warm glass-bottle gurgle.
One soft bootstep across dusty stone, kept quiet for map movement.
An ancient stone gate wakes with a low airy resonance; a single cue, not a loop.
The gate opens into a warm three-note bronze release with a soft air tail.
A low fallen-stone resonance fading into dust; solemn and restrained.
Two quiet, descending wooden-stone knocks indicate an unavailable action.
A quiet panel opening: air, a small bronze resonance, and a stone latch.
A dry parchment tab change with a tiny brass confirmation tone.
A warm two-note brass confirmation for committed module actions.
A soft descending stone knock for closing or cancelling a panel.
A restrained dungeon encounter call: low stone, dark air, and rising bronze.
A focused bronze mark for selecting the current combat target.
A deliberate card-cast gesture: parchment sweep into a compact bronze strike.
The traveller receives a grounded impact with a short dark-room tail.
A heavier hostile lunge: low cavern air, rough motion, and a stone body.
A monster impact with a dense stone core and a bruised bronze ring.
A contained four-step bronze release for a completed battle.
